نحتظر (form VIII)
# نَحْتَظِرُ (naḥtaẓiru) /naħ.ta.ðˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
# نَحْتَظِرَ (naḥtaẓira) /naħ.ta.ðˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
# نَحْتَظِرْ (naḥtaẓir) /naħ.ta.ðˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
